# SI026 — llm-json-parsed-without-guard

LLM JSON must be parsed behind a try/except guard.

## Why

Models return malformed JSON. An unguarded parse aborts the transaction instead of failing closed with a verdict.

## Bad

```python
parsed = json.loads(raw_llm_output)
```

## Good

```python
parsed = _safe_json(raw_llm_output)
if parsed is None: fail_closed()
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI026 -- reason
```
